## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, server/channel/user IDs, hostnames or gateway URLs
- [ ] No raw transcripts, chronicles or logs; excerpts are short, scrubbed and OK'd by the operator
- [ ] No people named or described without their consent
- [ ] Host and framework versions and the date are stated
- [ ] Extensions: README written, `npm run check` passes
